Classifying unit-gap runs yields every row for all positive integer x,y. In the only five-term-run cases, block starts even; any contained 0..3 therefore forces it to start 0 and include 4. Explicit positive/signed three-point witnesses realize every listed length. Finite exact verifier ran VERIFY_OK for 50,000 translated gap triples and complete three-subsets of [-15,15], only as independent finite checks.

value.rationale: This is a natural exact first unresolved three-generator/two-summand case of the signed and free-interval spectra explicitly posed in the contemporary literature (Problems 7-9 of arXiv:2605.26425v3). The gap-pattern classification yields a structural inverse theorem (four consecutive pair sums force five) and distinguishes signed initial coverage {0,1,2,4} from nonnegative {0,2,4} while proving the missing natural length three. The gap rule is a complete family classification, not an arbitrary numerical cut or a mere restatement of the maximum.
